title: Detect the agent identity from the running tool
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. SUSI_AGENT is inferred from parent process and tool markers (codex, claude, cursor, gemini, devin) so claims and task ids need no setup. Tests zc_agent_identity_*.
